facts_of_case: The wife filed a petition under Section 12(1)(c) of the Hindu Marriage Act for declaration that the marriage is a nullity due to the husband's suspicion about her mental capacity.

legal_principles.principle: The standard of proof is as in all civil cases, where the belief regarding the existence of a fact may be founded on a balance of probabilities.
legal_principles.held: Their Lordships of the Supreme Court held that the standard of proof is as in all civil cases. The first step in this process is to fix the probabilities, the second to weigh them, though the two may often intermingle.
cited_cases: Dr. N.G. Destenc v. Mrs. S. Destane

legal_principles.principle: A prudent man faced with conflicting probabilities concerning a fact-situation will act on the supposition that the fact exists, if on weighing the various probabilities he finds that the preponderance is in favour of the existence of the particular fact.
legal_principles.held: Their Lordships of the Supreme Court held as follows: A prudent man faced with conflicting probabilities concerning a fact-situation will act on the supposition that the fact exists, if on weighing the various probabilities he finds that the preponderance is in favour of the existence of the particular fact.
cited_cases: Dr. N.G. Destenc v. Mrs. S. Destane
